library_name: Destiny Jedi Academy Force Adept Talents
notes: Complete Force Adept prestige-class talent additions from the Jedi Academy Training Manual, with tree and prerequisite relationships.

rules.name: Dark Side Talisman
rules.description: Imbue a portable object with dark-side energy that protects one defense from light-side powers.

mechanics.effect: Choose Fortitude, Reflex, or Will when creating the talisman. While carrying it, gain +2 Force bonus to that defense against Force powers with the light-side descriptor.
mechanics.special: Only one dark-side talisman may be active, though a normal Force talisman may coexist. If destroyed, another cannot be created for 24 hours.

rules.name: Greater Dark Side Talisman
rules.description: Your dark-side talisman protects all three defenses from light-side powers.

mechanics.effect: Dark Side Talisman's +2 Force bonus applies simultaneously to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will against light-side Force powers.

rules.name: Charm Beast
rules.description: Use the Force instead of ordinary persuasion to calm and befriend unintelligent wild creatures.

mechanics.effect: Substitute Use the Force for Persuasion when changing the attitude of an undomesticated Intelligence 2-or-less creature. Ignore the normal -5 language-barrier penalty.
mechanics.special: Identical to the Dathomiri Witch talent of the same name for prerequisite purposes.

rules.name: Bonded Mount
rules.description: Create a lasting empathic bond with a friendly domesticated beast used as your mount.

mechanics.use: Full-round action; spend 1 Force Point when encountering a friendly or helpful domesticated beast.
mechanics.effect: Bond it as your mount and sense its emotions freely. While riding, it uses your Reflex and Will defenses and you gain any special senses it possesses that you lack.

rules.name: Entreat Beast
rules.description: Direct a small beast to deliver, retrieve, or manipulate a nearby object.

mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, the beast performs one minor task: deliver an object from you to a target within 30 squares, retrieve a visible unattended object within 30 squares and bring it to you, or activate an unattended button, lever, or similar control within 30 squares.

rules.name: Soothing Presence
rules.description: Wild beasts instinctively become less hostile when encountering you.

mechanics.trigger: Encounter a beast with an unfriendly attitude toward you.
mechanics.effect: Its attitude automatically becomes indifferent without a check.

rules.name: Wild Sense
rules.description: Borrow a nearby friendly beast's perceptions and line of sight.

mechanics.target: One indifferent-or-better beast within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: The beast immediately makes an active Perception check; you perceive everything it perceives and have line of sight to everything it sees until the end of your turn.

rules.name: Channel Vitality
rules.description: Convert your physical condition into a temporary surge of Force energy.

mechanics.cost: Move -1 step down the condition track.
mechanics.effect: Gain 1 temporary Force Point usable before the end of your turn; otherwise it is lost.

rules.name: Closed Mind
rules.description: Force enemies to take the worse of two attempts when mentally influencing you.

mechanics.trigger: A mind-affecting effect targets your Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: The attacker rolls its attack or skill check twice and must use the lower result.

rules.name: Esoteric Technique
rules.description: Force techniques and secrets fortified by a Force Point also reinforce your vitality.

mechanics.trigger: Spend a Force Point to activate a Force technique or Force secret.
mechanics.effect: Gain bonus hit points equal to 10 + your Force Adept class level.
mechanics.duration: Until encounter end; damage removes bonus hit points first.

rules.name: Mystic Mastery
rules.description: Your breadth of Force talents increases the Force Points gained whenever you level.

mechanics.effect: Gain additional Force Points equal to the number of Force talents you possess, maximum +6.

rules.name: Regimen Aptitude
rules.description: Perform learned Force regimens with exceptional consistency.

mechanics.effect: Gain +5 Force bonus on skill checks made to perform a Force regimen.

rules.name: Mind Probe
rules.description: Touch a creature and search its mind for rumors, secrets, or another person's location.

mechanics.check: Against an unwilling target, Use the Force must first meet Will Defense; the same result must also meet the relevant Gather Information DC.
mechanics.effect: Retrieve information using Learn News and Rumors, Learn Secret Information, or Locate Individual without bribes and within this action.
mechanics.special: Failing by 5+ does not reveal that you sought the information.

rules.name: Perfect Telepathy
rules.description: Transmit complete sentences and complex thoughts through telepathy.

mechanics.effect: When using the Telepathy application of Use the Force, you may communicate full sentences and complete thoughts rather than basic phrases.
mechanics.special: The recipient can still answer only with basic emotions or a single thought unless it has equivalent capability.

rules.name: Psychic Citadel
rules.description: Build a mental fortress whose strength grows with your Force Adept training.

mechanics.effect: Gain a Force bonus to Will Defense equal to your Force Adept class level.

rules.name: Psychic Defenses
rules.description: Mind-affecting Force powers aimed at you lash back against their user.

mechanics.trigger: Another creature targets you with a Force power bearing the mind-affecting descriptor.
mechanics.effect: That creature automatically takes Force damage equal to 1d6 times your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1d6.

rules.name: Telepathic Intruder
rules.description: Once you breach a mind, subsequent mental Force effects become easier to impose.

mechanics.trigger: Successfully affect a target with a mind-affecting Force power.
mechanics.effect: Gain +2 Force bonus on skill checks to activate mind-affecting Force powers and talents against that same target.
mechanics.duration: Until the end of your next turn.
